277557890.description:
Natural Utah Septarian Nodule
Dragon Stone Geode Specimen
Natural Limestone, Calcite, and Aragonite
7" L x 4" W x 5" H
2.85 lbs
This striking Septarian nodule, also known as "Dragon Stone," originates from Utah and dates back to the Cretaceous period, approximately 50 to 70 million years ago. The specimen has been professionally cut to reveal a complex interior of honey-yellow calcite crystals and dark brown aragonite veins set against a gray limestone matrix. The distinctive geometric patterns, formed through the drying and cracking of sedimentary clay balls, make each piece a unique work of natural history.
Features a prominent central vug lined with sparkling drusy calcite crystals
Displays classic septaria patterns with high-contrast aragonite bordering
Natural exterior limestone rind provides a rugged, organic contrast to the polished face
Condition:
Good natural condition with a polished display face. A significant structural crack is present on the outer limestone shell, extending through the rind but appearing stable. The interior crystals are intact and vibrant. As a natural geological specimen, minor surface variations and inclusions are present.
